last_reply: The screenshot shows a browser security error about the page linking to a local file. I'll look for where that comes from, and also check how the sign-up email is sent.The sign-up page now has a "Send again" button for the confirmation email. It also tells you when an address is already registered (Supabase sends no new email in that case), and logging in before confirming now says the address isn't confirmed yet instead of "wrong password". The most likely reason no email arrived is a Supabase setting I can't change: its built-in email service only sends to your project's team members' addresses, a few times an hour. To fix that, add your own email provider under Authentication → SMTP in the Supabase dashboard, and put `https://zvezdicav2.vercel.app` in the Site URL and Redirect URLs. The "file:///" error in your screenshot doesn't come from the app (nothing in it links to a local file); it's probably a browser extension or Firefox's privacy protection, and I haven't tested any of this against your live site.
